description: Guided opt-out fer Hunter, which lists folk by email address. One opt-out covers every saved email address.
instructions: Hunter shows folk's work email addresses. Open https://hunter.io/ an' click, matey, "Do Not Sell My Info" at the bottom. Fer each of these addresses, claim it, open the link Hunter sends to it, then smash "Delete my information": {all_emails}. Then smash "I've done this".
